slides: Your muscles get bored too.

Mix it up weekly and watch strength bloom.

Micro-decisions flood your brain with dopamine spikes.

Delay, decide, dominate.

Circadian rhythm dictates hormone release, not your alarm.

When they sync, recovery becomes automatic.
Lock your bedtime; the gains will follow.
